payload.reason: The evidence provides clear insights into the practical applications of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity set expansion methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: Measuring MAP at gold-k helps evaluate ESE methods in scenarios with large concept sizes, providing a more accurate estimate of recall and effectiveness in real-world applications.
The MAP at gold-k metric is designed to stress test ESE methods, revealing performance drops that indicate existing metrics may overestimate real-world effectiveness.
Using MAP at gold-k allows practitioners to assess the suitability of ESE methods for user-generated text, which often includes multifaceted and vague entities.
